scope.coverage: all shipped theme package directories except legacy palette-only aliases, plus Aster

query_filters.ai_art_filter: 0 (sent as advisory; not documented in current API help; not relied on)

policy.detail_filter: Reject AI-art tag 133451 and AI generator/tag names; also reject selected candidates tagged digital art/illustration/space art. Never equate absence of a tag with certified non-AI provenance.
policy.copyright: All images remain property of original owners. Catalogue stores links/metadata only; full artworks and provider thumbnails are not redistributed.
policy.runtime: Advisory catalogue only. Parent owns network/cache/selection and replacing old generated defaults. Do not override a separate custom Wallpaper selection. No generated wallpaper fallback.

aster.rationale: Quiet coastal photography complements slate/porcelain surfaces and small Breeze captions.

dark.rationale: A single breaking wave low on dark blue water; generous untextured sky for the two upper-right cards.

light.rationale: Still-water reflection and pale peach sky; upper-right sky stays quiet behind opaque cards.

aster.placement: Center-fill; keep the shoreline in the lower half. Top information strip and small bottom dock leave the horizon open.
aster.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

brutalist.rationale: Strong photographic diagonals match hard edges; no decorative vector geometry is needed.

dark.rationale: Upward-looking monochrome skyscrapers echo square caption geometry.

light.rationale: A high-contrast cumulus study balances black edges against the yellow-paper mode.

brutalist.placement: Center-fill. Busy architecture/cloud edges require the theme's opaque black/yellow UI surfaces; not a transparent-text backdrop.
brutalist.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

caelestia.rationale: Photographic green and rose tones give Material You a natural source when explicitly enabled.

dark.rationale: Green aurora over a snowy road supports a dark left pill rail.

light.rationale: Rose-lit mountains and a pale moon give light tonal surfaces a restrained warm source.

caelestia.placement: Center-fill. Rail stays backed. These are recommendations, not a request to force wallpaper-derived colours over a chosen palette.
caelestia.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

frutiger-aero.rationale: Photographic water and clouds retain optimistic aqua without generated bubbles or hills.

dark.rationale: A small boat in a deep turquoise bay under a storm keeps the ocean-blue dark variant.

light.rationale: White cumulus against a clear blue sky supplies the fresh-air light variant.

frutiger-aero.placement: Center-fill. Use the taskbar's glass backing over waves/clouds; preserve any photographer watermark.
frutiger-aero.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

glyph-rice.rationale: Low-key city texture / white winter negative space keep the dot typography dominant.

dark.rationale: A monochrome aerial city forms a dark fine-grained texture behind white dots.

light.rationale: A lone tree in a white snow field leaves negative space for black dot type.

glyph-rice.placement: Center-fill. Test the giant upper-left clock against the skyline/tree; right circular cards remain opaque. Image itself contains no UI.
glyph-rice.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

gnome-adwaita-like.rationale: Cloud and mountain photography gives clean Adwaita-like surfaces breathing room.

dark.rationale: A warmly lit isolated cloud on dark sky supports a restrained top panel.

light.rationale: Canadian alpine lake and bright cloud banks complement light blue/gray headerbars.

gnome-adwaita-like.placement: Center-fill. Keep the cloud/shoreline central; native opaque popup surfaces protect text contrast.
gnome-adwaita-like.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

gruvbox-dark.rationale: Copper foliage and orange sandstone complement warm cream/charcoal rather than drawing contour lines.

dark.rationale: Larch treetops make burnt-orange marks on a near-black forest.

light.rationale: Sunlit Monument Valley sandstone brings a natural ochre paper counterpart.

gruvbox-dark.placement: Center-fill. Tiny flat top bar needs its opaque backing over foliage; keep the sandstone subject central above the small dock.
gruvbox-dark.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

kiln-court.rationale: Earth pigment comes from real sand and architecture rather than rendered vaults.

dark.rationale: Sepia pyramids and windblown sand echo the clay palette with a quiet sky.

light.rationale: Sunlit Death Valley dunes carry warm sand highlights and sculptural natural folds.

kiln-court.placement: Center-fill; keep the pyramid/dune crest away from the left widget column. Preserve the bottom pill-panel clearance.
kiln-court.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

macos.rationale: Natural alpine photography replaces synthetic curves without imitating an Apple asset.

dark.rationale: Moon over blue Mount Cook reflection keeps white top-panel text calm.

light.rationale: Soft snowy peaks and pale sky balance neutral light chrome.

macos.placement: Center-fill; keep peaks below the slim top panel. No desktop widget placement is required.
macos.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

moss-atlas.rationale: Actual woodland depth suits the organic right-hand instrument rail.

dark.rationale: Appalachian fog layers and evergreen silhouettes support the low-light green palette.

light.rationale: An overhead conifer canopy makes a structural green texture without drawn contour lines.

moss-atlas.placement: Center-fill; center the fog or tree pattern. The right rail must remain backed over foliage.
moss-atlas.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

mountain-neon-dot.rationale: Faithful snow-mountain photography with the reference's teal night atmosphere; no AI mountain illustration.

dark.rationale: Dark teal snowy peaks beneath a star field closely match the screenshot's mountain/sky proportions.

light.rationale: Snowfield and pale Swiss alpine sky provide a true light counterpart.

mountain-neon-dot.placement: Center-fill. Upper-left dot clock sits in sky; homelab panel keeps its backing over mountain contrast. No dock; top islands stay separate.
mountain-neon-dot.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

nextkde.rationale: Soft blue reflections fit the broad glass surfaces and top-panel / launch-dock composition.

dark.rationale: Maligne Lake reflection and dusk-blue cliffs support the cool glass palette.

light.rationale: Sunlit forested lake and pale sky give the light mode a fresh natural counterpoint.

nextkde.placement: Center-fill; preserve the waterline. Native cards need opaque backing over the detailed tree banks.
nextkde.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

nothing-dot.rationale: Real monochrome lighting and landscape complement the single red interface accent.

dark.rationale: Streetlights in fog produce small white dots in a near-black field.

light.rationale: A snowy mountain reflection supplies controlled monochrome tones for off-white surfaces.

nothing-dot.placement: Center-fill. Keep bright lamps away from the ring clock; use its actual backing. Top strip and small dock remain readable.
nothing-dot.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

orbit-glass.rationale: Use real astronomy/space photography rather than a synthetic eclipse. Right rail only.

dark.rationale: Milky Way above a Swiss valley supplies a real orbital context and dark edge for the right rail.

light.rationale: ISS cupola photograph frames Earth with dark structural edges; the right frame supports light rail contrast.

orbit-glass.placement: Center-fill; cupola geometry is part of the photograph, not UI. Inspect ultrawide crop before selecting. No dock.
orbit-glass.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

paper-signal.rationale: Monochrome still life and snow keep the editorial palette in charge.

dark.rationale: A black coffee cup and long shadow bring tactile paper-like quiet to dark mode.

light.rationale: Snow peaks floating in white fog leave broad low-detail paper-white space.

paper-signal.placement: Center-fill. Keep the cup/peaks visible; the existing widgets use backed cards, not text directly on the subject.
paper-signal.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

signal-deck.rationale: Real orbital weather observations suit the scientific instrument layout without invented survey artwork.

dark.rationale: An ISS view of a spiral storm includes real station hardware and sea-blue cloud structure.

light.rationale: A brighter hurricane-eye photograph gives the light mode a precise observational subject.

signal-deck.placement: Center-fill; retain the eye of the storm. Split instrument bars require their native surfaces over cloud texture.
signal-deck.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

sweeteh.rationale: Real sky photography suits raised Material tiles and explicit native island surfaces.

dark.rationale: A sparse long-exposure star field gives dark tiles an unobtrusive field.

light.rationale: Pastel illuminated cloud tops echo the rounded light tiles.

sweeteh.placement: Center-fill; keep the cloud ridge below the right-side clock/weather/calendar stack. Preserve any photographer watermark; never crop specifically to remove it.
sweeteh.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

synthwave.rationale: Actual night lights and sunset colour replace the procedural sun/grid; no uncredited cyberpunk illustration.

dark.rationale: A photographed Japanese neon-sign building supplies cyan against black.

light.rationale: Purple sunset at a Japanese torii retains the neon hues in natural light.

synthwave.placement: Center-fill; left rail stays backed over signs. Torii is photographed scenery, not a launch control.
synthwave.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

terminal-minimal.rationale: Large quiet tonal fields respect a tiny bar and bare desktop clock.

dark.rationale: A nearly black hill under a thin warm horizon preserves the terminal focus.

light.rationale: Soft layers of misted ridges replace the black field without sharp detail.

terminal-minimal.placement: Center-fill; clock should stay in a quiet part of the sky. No dock. The light photograph is intentionally muted, not bright white.
terminal-minimal.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

tidal-loom.rationale: Natural repeated forms replace procedural weaving while keeping the cool material rhythm.

dark.rationale: Close-up fern leaflets have a tactile teal repetition.

light.rationale: A photographed wave washing over a chequered surface gives the light mode a real woven-looking rhythm.

tidal-loom.placement: Center-fill; left rail and upper-right cards need their existing solid/translucent backing over repeating detail. Parent has disabled the duplicate taskbar.
tidal-loom.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately

windows11.rationale: Wide natural horizons feel familiar behind a single centred taskbar.

dark.rationale: A dark Norwegian fjord creates a calm cool field around the centre work area.

light.rationale: Daylit Brule Lake with a distant train offers an open bright sky.

windows11.placement: Center-fill; keep the river/lake horizon and leave the bottom taskbar on its native backing. No additional rail.
windows11.crop_policy: keep original aspect; center-fill crops on aspect mismatch; verify ultrawide/portrait separately
